_note: Seed records extracted by hand from real work orders and email threads observed 2026-07-16 through 2026-07-30. This is a proof of the data model, not a complete dataset. Every field here came from an actual document — nothing is estimated. Prices are internal team figures from reply threads and have NOT been confirmed as sent to customers.

signals.evidence: I would like to set up a time for you to come out and review the equipment we have for sale and make us an offer. I would have you meet with our facilities and maintenance manager, Jeff Wohl.

cross_account_observations.observation: Regional CNC lathe supply is spiking right now
cross_account_observations.evidence: Lakes Area Mfg selling 2x Hardinge Cobra 65 + 2 bar feeders; Hydraulic Specialty selling 2 CNC machines; ACT Machinery just loaded out a Star swiss lathe. All within a two-week window.
cross_account_observations.action: Identify who in the book is expanding lathe capacity. Supply and demand are both visible in this data — nobody else can see both sides.

cross_account_observations.observation: Quote turnaround is a leak, not a capacity problem
cross_account_observations.evidence: ACT Machinery quote took 5 days with two customer chase-ups from Molly. Precision Air Products was priced internally 2 days after request. Rigid Hitch was priced internally but the number never reached the customer.
cross_account_observations.action: The bottleneck is not producing numbers — it is delivering them. Every priced-but-undelivered quote is finished work being thrown away.

cross_account_observations.observation: Campaign replies contain free machine inventories
cross_account_observations.evidence: Rigid Hitch volunteered five named machines. Lakes Area volunteered four. Neither was asked for a list.
cross_account_observations.action: Every campaign reply is an inventory disclosure. Capturing them builds the asset map at zero marginal cost.
